scripts.test:api: docker compose --profile test run --rm api-test uv run pytest
scripts.lint:api: docker compose --profile test run --rm api-test sh -c "uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app"
scripts.lint:web: docker compose run --rm --no-deps web sh -c "pnpm typecheck && pnpm exec eslint . && pnpm test"
scripts.test:web: docker compose run --rm --no-deps web pnpm test
scripts.test:workers: docker compose --profile test run --rm --no-deps pcap-worker-test sh -c "ruff check . /packages/py-worker-kit && ruff format --check . /packages/py-worker-kit && mypy pcap_worker tests dataset /packages/py-worker-kit/src && pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider && cd /packages/py-worker-kit && pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -o cache_dir=/tmp/pc" && docker compose --profile test run --rm --no-deps static-worker-test sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy static_worker tests samples && pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider && cd /packages/py-worker-kit && pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -o cache_dir=/tmp/pc" && docker compose --profile test run --rm --no-deps report-worker-test sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy report_worker tests && pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/" && docker compose --profile test run --rm --no-deps memory-worker-test sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy memory_worker tests samples && pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider && cd /packages/py-worker-kit && pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -o cache_dir=/tmp/pc"
scripts.memory:fuzz: bash scripts/lane-test.sh 4 --service memory-worker-test --heavy sh -c "MEMORY_FUZZ=1 pytest -q -s -p no:cacheprovider tests/fuzz"
